title: ActiveActivity
description: In-progress activity. Slice 5B1 adds optional runtime provenance fields (runtime_context / causes / details / decision_evidence) for Foundation compatibility; 5B1 runtime-started activities must always include all four. Slice 5B2C1 adds optional dynamics_context (required on C1 runtime-started activities). Slice 5B2C2B adds optional runtime_finish_context (required on C1 runtime-started activities after 5B2C2B; start-time factual inputs for end-effect derivation).

planned_end.description: Optional exact plan; not required. Prefer expected_end / expected_end_window.

pending_captures.description: Optional temporary capture facts while activity is active. Not Camera Roll media. Missing means none.

runtime_context.description: Slice 5B1 action-selection provenance retained until finalization. Optional at schema level for Foundation fixtures; required on 5B1 runtime-started activities. Does not persist continuation_feasible.

source_kind.description: Causal source of the selected candidate. CURRENT_ACTIVITY is not persisted as underlying source.

rule_ids.description: Unique non-empty strings; canonical sorted semantically.

causes.description: Exact ActualEvent.causes subcontract. Optional for Foundation; required on 5B1 runtime-started activities.

details.description: Exact ActualEvent.details subcontract. Optional for Foundation; runtime-started activities must satisfy ActualEvent activity_type conditioning.

decision_evidence.description: Exact ActualEvent.decision_evidence subcontract. Optional for Foundation; required and non-null on 5B1 runtime-started activities.

dynamics_context.description: Slice 5B2C1 Slice-2B rate context. Optional at schema level for Foundation fixtures; required on 5B2C1 runtime-started activities.

runtime_finish_context.description: Slice 5B2C2B start-time factual inputs frozen for end-effect derivation. Optional at schema level for Foundation/legacy fixtures; required on C1 runtime-started activities after 5B2C2B. Not copied wholesale into ActualEvent. Action-specific gating is enforced by C1 population and C2B validation.

sleep_need_min.description: Frozen SLEEP_MAIN sleep_need_min at start; null for other action kinds.

travel_destination_location_id.description: Frozen TRAVEL_TO_COMMITMENT destination location_id at start; null for other action kinds.

task_effort_remaining_at_start_min.description: Frozen STUDY/ERRAND TASK effort_remaining_min at start; null for other action kinds.
